title: Fix restaurant config clone date serialization

notes: Root cause fixed at the shared snapshot/import boundary. CI run 8246 passed the existing backup service suite (38/38), the new date/clone regression suite (2/2), and backup resolver tests (14/14). Full CI remained red only for unrelated capability-gating and frontend unit-test failures.
